qualification_scope: Direct pinned Laya MLX upstream candidate; not Sys1 runtime integration or default qualification.

methodology.stop_rule: Stop after three consecutive invalid/error responses; no retries. Stop immediately on request timeout and collect owned process.
methodology.latency_boundary: Python Agent.predict through complete evaluated response; excludes process IPC, Sys1 normalization/validation, model load and HTTP.
methodology.throughput_boundary: Measured loop wall time including process IPC and normalization/validation; excludes model load, report persistence and permutations.
methodology.usage: Upstream retained unpadded sequence tokens summed across rows, including special tokens and repeated state; exact full-input equality preflight excludes truncation. Output zero: classifier returns probabilities without generated answer text.
methodology.normalization: Preserve raw_response including original model, action fields, and noul confidence. Explicit normalized projection uses pinned checkpoint identity, drops action and noul confidence, preserves all probabilities and other SystemOne fields without modification.
methodology.grading: Sys1 frozen decisions-v3 gradeDecision and validateResponseForRequest. Choice exact label; noul threshold0.5 and ties incorrect; score unique probability argmax and ties incorrect; score MAE separately.
methodology.quality_scope: Exploratory direct-upstream evidence on72 authored synthetic cases across9families; frozen before execution. Not a production benchmark, calibration study or independent third-party evaluation. Repeats/permutations are not independent cases.
methodology.invariance: Six valid identical semantic choices across every permutation; does not imply correctness.
methodology.confidence: Laya choice/score entropy confidence; noul maximum probability. Different semantics from Sys1 Qwen readout; not calibrated by this benchmark.
